# Underwriting Memo

**Risk summary**

Brenvale Living Communities owns and manages mid-rise apartment buildings in Houston, TX with on-site management. The account consists of three Houston locations with total insured value of $19.5M. All locations are inland (71-81 km from coast). The insured operates under class APTS (Apartments / habitational). Broker is Calvetti Insurance (Emerging) with a fit score of 71.

**Appetite and referral**

This risk is **IN** appetite per **AG-004** (APTS is a target class, write up to $35M TIV per account) and **AG-014** (inland Southeast/Central locations acceptable). The $19.5M TIV is well within the $35M account limit. No appetite concerns identified.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history shows 6 claims totaling $233,400 incurred. Notable pattern of theft claims (2021, 2025) with one open claim from 2025. Vehicle into storefront claim in 2022 ($94,800 incurred). Clean years in 2023-2024. Loss frequency and severity appear moderate for the exposure.

**Exposure and concentration**

Significant concentration exists with $317.2M portfolio TIV within 25km of each location, indicating heavy Houston market penetration. All three properties cluster in the same metropolitan area.

**Recommendation**

Suggest binding subject to review of theft prevention measures given recurring theft losses and the open 2025 claim. Consider concentration impact on portfolio management.
